name: Testing Pack
description: Evidence Ledger discipline for tests — captures real verify output and guards against regressions instead of trusting a green claim.
evidence_required: pass/fail counts from the captured run

harness_score_contribution.note: Feeds Evidence with captured VERIFY_CMD output, and surfaces remaining gaps as open_risks rather than letting 'tests pass' close them silently.

exit_criteria: no failing tests in the captured run
regression note recorded in the brief

analytical_proofs.note: Opt-in (tdd workflow only): proves test-first — the named red_command was logged as a FAILED test run and the green_command as a PASSED one. Verified by verifyTddRedGreen against the independent tool log, not verifyAnalytical (a RED run can't be an objective proof — verifyProof rejects exit != 0).
